# Jazeel Zainudeen - Full Stack Engineer & Cloud Architect

## Summary
Jazeel Zainudeen is a Senior Full Stack Engineer based in Kerala, India with over 5+ years of production experience building modern web applications, high-performance Cloud solutions, Next.js / React platforms, custom enterprise ERP/CRM systems, and scalable APIs.

## Primary Skills & Tech Stack
- **Frontend & Modern Web**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Modern Web Architecture
- **Backend & Cloud**: Node.js, PHP, Laravel, REST APIs, GraphQL, Serverless / Cloud Architecture
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, MySQL, Supabase
- **Architecture**: Modern Web Applications, Custom ERP Systems, CRM Platforms, Legacy App Modernization, Cloud Migration
